big_picture_notes: 1 Timothy is a pastoral letter structured by two major charges to Timothy, framed by greeting and benediction. It blends hortatory imperatives with didactic instruction to combat false teaching and to establish godly order in the church. Literary glue includes the contrast between sound teaching and myths/genealogies, the ‘mystery of godliness’ (3:16) as theological center, and an inclusio of charge→exposition→practice that returns to a climactic final charge. The flow moves from personal commission (ch. 1) to corporate worship and leadership (chs. 2–3), then to practical godliness against error (chs. 4–5), culminating in warnings about wealth and a solemn oath‑charge (ch. 6).

stories.story_title: Initial Charge: The Purpose of the Law and Warning Against False Teaching
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (1:3) ‘remain at Ephesus… charge certain persons’ sets the narrative/imperative purpose; end (1:20) names Hymenaeus and Alexander, concretizing the warning. Glue: law/teaching vocabulary (nomos/didaskalia) and a doxology (1:17) that underwrites the charge’s authority.

scenes.scene_name: Salutation and The Immediate Commission
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Apostolic greeting flows into the first directive to stop different doctrine. Devices: commission verb ‘charge’ (paraggellō), conflict markers (myths, genealogies).

scenes.scene_name: The Goal of the Charge vs Vain Discussion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Aim is love from pure heart, good conscience, sincere faith; ends with would‑be law‑teachers lacking understanding. Devices: antithesis (love vs vain talk), purpose definition.

scenes.scene_name: The Proper Use of the Law
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Law is good if used lawfully; vice list shows its target; closes with ‘glorious gospel’ trust. Devices: enumerated parallelism, law/gospel linkage.

scenes.scene_name: Paul’s Call and Mercy Testimony
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Thanksgiving for strength and mercy; ‘chief of sinners’; sealed by doxology. Devices: autobiographical ethos, climactic doxology (1:17).

scenes.scene_name: Reiteration of the Charge and Consequence
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: ‘This charge I entrust…’ wage the good warfare; names delivered to Satan. Devices: warfare metaphor, exempla of discipline, inclusio with 1:3.

stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (2:1) ‘First of all, then…’ marks the shift to assembly life; end (3:16) confessional hymn on the mystery of godliness crowns the order instructions. Glue: order/propriety (kosmios) and godliness (eusebeia) recur; leadership qualifications anchor corporate structure.

scenes.scene_name: Pray for All; God Desires All to Be Saved
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Prayers for all people and rulers, pleasing to God our Savior, who desires all to be saved.

scenes.scene_name: One God, One Mediator, a Ransom for All
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: One mediator, Christ Jesus, who gave Himself a ransom — for which Paul was appointed a herald.

scenes.scene_name: Men Pray; Women Adorned with Good Works
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Men to pray without anger; women to adorn themselves with modesty and good deeds, not finery.

scenes.scene_name: Women Learn Quietly; Saved Through Childbearing
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A woman to learn quietly in submission, with the appeal to creation order and the childbearing promise.

scenes.scene_name: The Overseer Above Reproach
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Aspiring to overseer is noble; he must be above reproach, self-controlled, and managing his household well.

scenes.scene_name: Not a Recent Convert; Well Regarded Outside
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: One who cannot manage his house cannot care for the church; not a novice, with a good outside reputation.

scenes.scene_name: Qualifications for Deacons (and Women)
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: ‘Deacons likewise…’ tested first; reward of good standing; women/wives directive (3:11). Devices: examination process, parallel attributes, translational ambiguity noted.

scenes.scene_name: The Mystery of Godliness (Why Order Matters)
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Purpose of writing: conduct in God’s household; church as pillar/buttress; hymn on the mystery of godliness. Devices: architectural metaphor, creedal six‑line confession.

stories.story_title: Instructions for Godly Living and Confronting Error
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (4:1) Spirit’s explicit oracle marks new unit on error and godliness; end (5:25) moral maxim on conspicuous works closes the household/office guidance before slave instructions. Glue: godless myths vs training for godliness; imperative cadence (‘command/teach’).

scenes.scene_name: Source and Error of Future Apostasy
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Spirit says: some depart; forbidding marriage/foods countered by creation’s goodness. Devices: prophetic oracle, enumeration, consecration rationale.

scenes.scene_name: A Good Servant Nourished on the Faith
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Trained in godliness rather than myths, laboring in hope set on the living God, the Savior of all.

scenes.scene_name: Set an Example; Watch Your Life and Doctrine
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Let no one despise his youth; devote himself to Scripture and teaching, watching life and doctrine closely.

scenes.scene_name: Relating to Different Ages
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Do not rebuke older man; appeal as father/brother/mother/sister with purity. Devices: family metaphor, paired parallelism.

scenes.scene_name: Care of Widows I: Qualifications
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Honor true widows; family duty emphasized; failure worse than unbelief. Devices: casuistic instruction, severe censure for neglect.

scenes.scene_name: Enrolling Widows; the Younger Widows' Idleness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The qualifications for enrolled widows and the warning of younger widows growing idle and gossiping.

scenes.scene_name: Younger Widows Marry; Relieve the Truly Widowed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Younger widows to marry and manage homes; believing women to support their widows, easing the church.

scenes.scene_name: Honor Elders; Charges and Rebuke
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Double honor for laboring elders, charges only on two witnesses, and impartial public rebuke of sin.

scenes.scene_name: Lay Hands Hastily on None; Sins Become Evident
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Do not ordain hastily or share in sins; some sins and good works are evident, others surface later.

stories.story_title: Final Admonitions, Danger of Wealth, and Closing Charge
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (6:1) slave/master instruction opens final cluster; end (6:21) ‘Grace be with you’ closes letter. Glue: godliness vs love of money, ‘sound words’ vs controversy, and a solemn oath‑charge (6:11–16) forming inclusio with the opening charge.

scenes.scene_name: Slaves Honor Masters; Beware Greedy Teachers
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Slaves to honor masters; a warning against conceited teachers who imagine godliness a means of gain.

scenes.scene_name: Godliness with Contentment; the Love of Money
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Godliness with contentment is great gain; the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.

scenes.scene_name: Timothy’s Solemn Charge and Oath
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Flee/pursue; fight the good fight; keep the command unstained until appearing; doxological depiction of God. Devices: covenantal charge, parallel imperatives, oath by confession, mini‑doxology.

scenes.scene_name: Instruction for the Rich
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Charge the rich: not haughty, hope in God, be rich in good works; lay up a firm foundation. Devices: contrast trust, financial metaphor for treasure.

scenes.scene_name: Final Summary and Farewell
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Guard the deposit; avoid profane chatter/contradictions; grace be with you. Devices: deposit metaphor (parathēkē), inclusio with opening charge, benediction formula.
